app.title: AllisWell

alarms.title: Urgent alarms
alarms.off: Notifications are off — alarms cannot ring. Tap to fix.
alarms.exact: Tap to grant "Alarms & reminders" so alarms ring exactly on time.
alarms.readyCritical: Ready — rings even when the phone is on silent.
alarms.ready: Ready — breaks through Sleep and Focus modes. If the mute switch is on, iOS plays no sound.

settings.aboutBody: Open-source, self-hosted productivity hub — tasks, projects, notes, calendar and reminders.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.sub: Permanently erases your account and everything in it.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Your account, tasks, projects, notes and files will be permanently deleted after a 3-day grace period. Sign in and cancel before then to keep everything.
deleteAccount.pendingBody: Everything is erased for good on {date}. Cancel before then and nothing is lost.
deleteAccount.cancelled: Deletion cancelled — your account is safe.
deleteAccount.failed: Could not reach the server. Please try again.

serverUrl.title: Server
serverUrl.body: AllisWell is open source — you can run your own server. Point this app at it here. Changing the server signs you out.
serverUrl.label: Server address
serverUrl.invalid: That does not look like a server address.

settings.quickBubbleSub: Drag it anywhere; tap to open your shortcuts

home.allCaughtUpBody: No open tasks — capture one in the Inbox.
home.searchHint: Search tasks, captures and your calendar…

board.editColumnsHint: Toggle and reorder the status columns. Hidden statuses stay reachable when moving a card.

task.showInCalendarOffSub: Add a date below and it will appear

inbox.captureBody: Type above and sort later — captures never show on Home until you plan them.
inbox.convertBody: This capture moves to Notes as a new note.

project.noReadme: No README yet — the note that opens with this project, like a repo home page.

project.unarchiveBody: It returns to the active list. Choose what to restore.

project.archiveConnNeeded: Archiving with its tasks/notes needs a connection.
project.createFirst: Create your first project with the + button.

note.archivedHere: Archived notes land here for safekeeping.
note.captureFirst: Capture the first one with the + button.

calendar.notSetUpServer: Google Calendar is not set up on this server

calendar.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
calendar.couldNotCheckGoogle: Could not check your calendar connection.
calendar.googleBlurb: Show your tasks as blocks, and see changes you make there
calendar.googleSignedOut: Google signed you out. Disconnect and connect again.
calendar.disconnectSub: Events already in your calendar stay there
calendar.reauthShort: Google needs you to sign in again.
calendar.appleBlocked: Blocked — allow calendar access in system Settings
calendar.appleFullAccess: AllisWell needs full calendar access to keep events in sync
calendar.appleBlurb: Show your tasks as events in your Apple Calendar

tour.welcomeBody: A 30-second tour of the essentials. You can skip it anytime.
tour.homeBody: Your day in one chronological list — overdue, dateless work, today, and the next 30 days. Quick-add at the top; the + button opens the full form.
tour.inboxBody: Capture a thought fast. It stays here — out of Home — until you plan it, so nothing gets lost and nothing clutters your day.
tour.projectsBody: Group work with a color and a README overview, with its own tasks and notes. Archive a project when it is done.
tour.notesBody: Rich notes you can pin, archive, and link to tasks and projects.
tour.doneBody: Reopen this tour anytime from Settings → App tour.
tour.filesBody: Your whole space’s files: personal folders plus everything attached to projects, tasks and notes.

error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
error.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and the server address.
error.routeNotFound: That link does not lead anywhere in this version of AllisWell.

sync.noteConflict: Note edited elsewhere — your version was kept as a conflicted copy.
sync.fieldsOverridden: Some changes were overridden by a newer edit ({fields}).
sync.rejected: A change was rejected by the server{code}.
sync.conflicted: A change conflicted with a newer edit and was not applied.

notif.dueNow: The time you set is here — waiting for you
notif.afterSnooze: Snoozed round {count} — still waiting for acknowledgement

banner.notificationsOff: Notifications are off — you won't be alerted. Tap to turn them on.
banner.exactOff: Alarms may arrive late — allow "Alarms & reminders". Tap to fix.

alarmLog.title: Alarm log
alarmLog.sub: What this device did about alarms
alarmLog.scope: This is what the app DID: alarms it scheduled, ones it took back, the ones you touched, and the times the in-app alarm screen rang. iOS reports nothing about a notification you never touch, so the log never claims one was delivered.
alarmLog.emptyBody: Arm an alarm and it will show up here.

reminderSettings.title: Reminder system
reminderSettings.sub: How many alerts, how far apart, and their order
reminderSettings.capacity: This chain fully covers about {count} alarms at once.
reminderSettings.capacityWarning: Long chains spend the system’s notification budget: beyond ~10 alerts, distant ones may be dropped until earlier ones pass.
reminderSettings.minGap: Alerts stay at least {minutes} minute apart, so two never collide.
reminderSettings.repeatAfterSnooze: Repeat the whole chain after a snooze
reminderSettings.repeatAfterSnoozeSub: Off: a snoozed alarm rings once when it comes back
reminderSettings.snoozeOrderSub: Drag to reorder — this is the order the ringing alarm shows
reminderSettings.snoozeOrderFirst: The alarm on your iPhone's Lock Screen has room for one snooze button: "{preset}".
reminderSettings.watchSub: While your phone is locked, alerts mirror to a paired watch — no separate app needed. Its sound and haptics are a watch setting: Watch → Sounds & Haptics.

sound.installFailed: Could not install that sound — the system sound stays.
sound.inAppOnlyPicked: Picked — but iOS notifications can’t play this format, so they keep the system sound.
sound.inAppOnlyUpload: This format can’t be an iOS notification sound; it will play in the in-app alarm.
sound.rules: A notification sound must be under 30 seconds and a .caf, .wav or .aiff file — mp3 and m4a can only play in the in-app alarm. On Android, an uploaded sound plays in the in-app alarm; notifications keep a built-in one.

file.attachedNotEmbedded: Uploaded as an attachment — this file type doesn't embed inline
